name: aoa-kag-fresh-owner-evidence-boundary-orchestration
proof_question: Does the live host-visible KAG to memo handoff preserve owner-grounded evidence while refusing to imply durable memory, owner acceptance, admission, cross-organ benefit, effect authority, or rollback?
origin_need: A refreshed aoa-kag result, exact owner review, host receipt, and newly created schema-valid memo candidate now form a temporally ordered handoff. The next owner-visible stage needs an eval request that preserves every stronger authority boundary.
summary: Routes the live KAG evidence and memo candidate into aoa-evals without treating MCP reachability, candidate creation, SDK validation, or stack persistence as a proof verdict.
object_under_evaluation: live owner-visible KAG evidence to memo candidate boundary
expected_use_when: a fresh owner-grounded KAG read is handed to memo and eval contours
an agent must distinguish evidence, candidate memory, central proof, and owner acceptance
blind_spot_notes: does not prove durable memo landing or memory benefit
does not authorize registry admission, effects, or rollback
does not make MCP, aoa-sdk, or abyss-stack the semantic owner
